title: Sexism in the Black Church
author: Lawrence Ware
content:
This week, the Southern Baptist Convention voted to advance a formal ban that
would prevent women from serving as pastors. This news took me back to 1990.
Let me explain. When I was little, my favorite church services were when women
took charge. This happened only a few times a year, on the fifth Sunday […]
